title: Seldon preview
description: The output of `seldon preview --json` (WP-138, ADR-0045): before the logbook exists, the last days' pacman transactions and the files edited under ~/.config, read from the machine without memory (no who, no why). Read-only; the plugin runs the command with a fixed argv while the logbook is not initialised and shows this. Every name and path is user content: shown escaped, never evaluated, never an argument of a command.

since.description: the window's start: generatedAt minus days

ok.description: false: pacman.log could not be read; message says why, transactions is empty

partial.description: the log's last 64 MiB did not reach back to the window's start

transactions.description: newest first; only package lines inside the window

at.description: when it began (its Running line, else transaction started), or its first line inside the window

command.description: pacman's Running line, redacted, one line; absent without one or while config.toml cannot be used

count.description: its package lines inside the window, also those not listed

kinds.description: the kinds of all its package lines inside the window, each once, in log order

ok.description: false: withheld (config.toml or its [redaction] patterns cannot be used); message says so, items is empty

partial.description: the walk stopped early (time or entry budget, depth): files it did not reach are missing

root.description: the folder walked, ~/.config or $XDG_CONFIG_HOME, as ~/… when under the home

items.description: newest first; never a file under a [redaction] skipPaths pattern, never content

path.description: ~/…, redacted, control and bidi characters as U+FFFD

truncated.description: a bound cut rows: more than 200 rows (transactions plus files), more than 80 files, or more than 10 packages in a transaction
